title: dispatch-gates: a key added to a nested served schema (ListColumnSchema, InlineGridColumnSchema, ColumnPrefixSchema, ColumnSummaryConfigSchema, the lookupAutofill pair) derives no metadata-core object-schema-fls-references test
body:
repo:objectstack#8 · os-mickey · session_01ASNY8UcT2uJmgTyCPnMiMZ

Blocked-by: #37882

Filing gate: ① defect with a named location, same failure class as #37064 · Source: fleet (os-dev report 7213921132 on #37064, out-of-scope finding class a)

## What happens

`packages/metadata-core`'s object-schema-fls-references test pins NESTED key sets, not only top-level ones: its case "classifies every ListColumnSchema key, and nothing it no longer declares" reds on a key added to `ListColumnSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`). PR #37882 (Fixes #37064) teaches `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` the top-level key sets of the served types; a nested one still derives nothing. The dev's probe in a throwaway worktree (at `3cafa1d2`): a key added to `ListColumnSchema` ⇒ `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` printed 0 metadata-core lines. Not measured by the seat.

Family, one card: the nested key-set pins in that test (`InlineGridColumnSchema`, `ListColumnSchema`, `ColumnPrefixSchema`, `ColumnSummaryConfigSchema`, the `lookupAutofill` pair inline in `FieldSchema`) and the metadata-protocol test's `view` union arm count (4).

## Expected

A diff that changes one of those nested key sets (or the `view` arm count) derives the pin test that holds it, read from the diff as #37882 reads the top-level sets, not by a path match. The dev notes the `lookupAutofill` pair is inline in `FieldSchema`, so it is no mechanical table row: the fix says how it is read.

Surface: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `.data.mjs`, `.self-test.mjs`. Guard instrument ⇒ Tier H. Serial after PR #37882 (same hot file; this seat's dispatch-gates serial queue).
Business reason: each missed derivation costs a dev a wasted CI round (#36483 measured it twice for `field`).
Reader who acts: seat `repo:objectstack#8` (area:fleet p1/p2).
Dedupe (2026-11-27, issues, open and closed): `ListColumnSchema dispatch-gates` 14 hits, open: #37064 (this card's parent class) and #6015 (a seat post); `object-schema-fls-references` 124 hits, the only open one #37064; `nested key set derives` 251 hits, the only open one #37064. No card on nested key-set derivation.
Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none
Grade: area:fleet · Bug · a dev-tooling gap with CI as backstop, same class as #37064 → p2.
